title: Enterprise printer model research catalogue
purpose: Research candidate inventory for a vendor-neutral device fleet platform; no application support is implemented or certified by this catalogue.
counting_rule: Distinct brand + model prefix + base model identifier; suffix/Flow/SKU examples and generic licence identities are not counted as extra base models. Includes earlier-report candidates.

interpretation.model_source_ids: Establish model identity and the stated model_evidence; they do not establish all management-profile operations for every sibling.
interpretation.management_profile: Vendor/platform context; only operation_evidence establishes the narrower documented scope.
interpretation.release_year: Null means unverified. A support-table date, page creation date or firmware date is not a launch year.
interpretation.lifecycle: Regional availability and firmware/service support are independent. Vendor management listings may include older devices.
interpretation.qualification_status: Every entry remains research_candidate_unvalidated. No support manifest or production capability flags have been changed.
interpretation.variant_matching: Retain raw model, badge, product number, serial, controller and component firmware; do not cross-flash based on shared family.
interpretation.source_access: official_search_index means primary-source indexed extracts, not a full document read. Inherited source access notes are retained.
